name: UGC phone video (creator ads and testimonials)
description: Ads and posts that should feel filmed by a real person on their phone: selfie testimonials, unboxings, product demos.
look: A frame from a vertical video filmed on a modern smartphone front camera by a real person at home: phone-camera wide lens, slight edge distortion, auto-exposure and auto-white-balance look, mixed window daylight and room light, mild phone noise and sharpening, everyday background clutter. Authentic, unpolished, not a studio production.
imageRules: Product packaging and logos must match the product reference exactly with readable, correct text. The creator holds the product naturally at arm's length. Real skin texture.
negative: studio lighting, cinematic grade, shallow cinema depth of field, perfect skin, stock-photo smile, glossy ad look, warped packaging text, extra fingers, collage
camera: Selfie arm's-length framing, chest-up, slight handheld drift, occasional reframing; product close-ups held toward the lens. No tripod-smooth moves, no drone, no dolly.
motion: Handheld selfie micro-shake and natural reframing; the creator talks with real energy, glances at the product, gestures; product labels stay sharp and readable.

characterSheet.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four phone-camera frames of the same {who} filmed at home in {set}: top-left selfie facing camera at arm's length, top-right three-quarter, bottom-left side profile, bottom-right full body in a mirror. {look}. Identical face, hair and outfit in all four. Thin white gutters. No text, no labels.

frame.product: Product shape, colors, logo and label text are identical to the product reference and readable.
frame.authenticity: Feels filmed by a real person on a phone, not a studio ad.

clip.product: Product stays correct and readable through the whole clip.
clip.authenticity: Phone-video feel holds: handheld, natural, no ad gloss.
